name: grantcompass-canada
description: Find Canadian business grants, wage subsidies, loans and tax credits, and check basic eligibility.

interface.longDescription:
GrantCompass Canada searches more than 850 current Canadian funding programmes: federal, provincial, municipal and private grants, plus wage subsidies, tax credits, loans and awards for businesses, start-ups and non-profits. Describe your business and what you need money for, and it returns the programmes that fit, with the amount, whether each one is open right now, why it fits, and a link to its full page.

Ask whether you qualify for a specific programme and it checks the basic requirements (province, type of organization, size, years operating, industry), tells you which you meet, and asks for anything it needs to know. It only checks basic requirements. Each programme has more conditions on its page, so a "likely fit" is never a guarantee.

No account needed. Covers Canadian programmes only (for the United States, see GrantCompass US). Not for scholarships, student aid or personal finance.
capabilities: Check basic eligibility for a programme
defaultPrompt: Find grants for my bakery in Ontario
Funding to hire summer students in BC
Am I eligible for CanExport SMEs?

positive.description: Search funding for a described business
positive.prompt: Find grants for my bakery in Ontario.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows programme cards with amount, current intake status and a base-level fit; every programme is open to Ontario businesses; each card links to its grantcompass.ca programme page.

positive.prompt: Are there grants to hire summer students for my company in Alberta?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_grants for Alberta with a hiring purpose; student and youth wage-subsidy programmes lead the results.

positive.description: Indirect request: paying for equipment before opening
positive.prompt: I'm opening a café in Vancouver next spring. How can I pay for the espresso machines and renovation?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_grants for a British Columbia food business that has not launched yet; returns programmes that fund equipment or start-up costs, and does not claim a programme that needs an operating business is a fit.

positive.description: Check eligibility for a named programme
positive.prompt: Am I eligible for CanExport SMEs? We're an incorporated software company in Ontario with 6 employees and $400K revenue.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows each basic requirement as met / not met / need to know, an overall likely-fit verdict, the current intake status, and what else to check on the programme page.

positive.prompt: Tell me about the Canada Summer Jobs program.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the funder, amount, current intake status, who it is for, and a link to the programme page.

negative.prompt: Find scholarships for my daughter starting university in Ontario.

publication.release_notes: First release. Three read-only tools: search Canadian funding programmes, check basic eligibility for one programme, and get a programme's details. No login. Results link to informational programme pages on grantcompass.ca.
